description: Renders the PDF for one employee equity-grant agreement (option/rsu/rsa/fast) and stores it; returns the S3 key. Generation is idempotent: when the agreement already has a PDF this returns it unchanged. A signed or void agreement is refused. regenerate=true (overwrite the existing PDF in place) is refused for assistants — ask the person to press Regenerate PDF in the app — and for any agreement out for signature.
name: cap_table_generate_cap_table_agreement_pdf
title: Generate Cap Table Agreement PDF
